remarks: NEW ROOF, NEW RENOVATIONS, NEW UPDATES, NEW PRICE... Lovely Victorian, Legal 2 Family, with LOADS of charm...Enjoy sitting on the wrap around porch, Enter through the gorgeous red double doors and a stunning stained glass Dutch door. Step into a Beautiful entrance lobby with carved wood staircase. Huge, multiple pane window that lets the sun shine in. First floor apartment consists of living room, kitchen, bathroom and 2 bedrooms with 9 ft ceilings on both floors. Second floor apartment consists of living room, kitchen, bathroom, 2 ENLARGED bedrooms and a staircase that leads to a H U G E attic, CLEANED and is brimming with possibilities and opportunity. Rear entrance offers a deck with a lovely view. 10,019 sq ft. Lot, Great back yard, Mature landscaping, Fenced Property. Full Basement with outside entrance, Laundry and Storage. Blacktop Driveway, parking for 6 cars and potential for more parking. Energy Efficient Gas Burner and separate Efficient Hot water tanks. Live in One and let the Other Unit Help with the Expenses, significant income potential! WALK to the East Norwalk Train Station. Enjoy All That Norwalk has to Offer including Shopping at the NEW SONO Collection Mall, Restaurants, Museums, Parks, Nightlife, Theatre, Festivals and more! An Easy Commute by Road (I95. Rt 7 & Merritt Pky). Less Than 1 Hour From NYC. Also, Close to the Westport Train Station.
